text.description_html:
Alarm Kit for Apex 2000 Series Exit Device, Best ALK-4 630

This battery operated alarm kit fits all Stanley Best Apex 2000 Series Exit Devices. Includes 9v battery with audible low battery indicator. Satin Stainless Steel finish. Prepped for Best SFIC, cylinder NOT included.

Sold Individually
